facebookresearch_mobile-vision/mobile_cv.load_data: load previously saved PyTorch .pth data by uid and name with optional CPU mapping

facebookresearch_mobile-vision/mobile_cv.launch_distributed_training: run a function across multiple processes and machines using the launch helper for distributed PyTorch training

facebookresearch_mobile-vision/mobile_cv.enable_dist_process_groups: build a context manager to initialize and manage NCCL or Gloo distributed process groups with a timeout
facebookresearch_mobile-vision/mobile_cv.interleave_by_rank: create a context manager to interleave code execution across ranks with a configurable concurrency limit
facebookresearch_mobile-vision/mobile_cv.process_group_with_timeout: build a temporary process group with a custom timeout for heavy distributed communication operations

facebookresearch_mobile-vision/mobile_cv.add_model_record_hook: add a forward hook to a PyTorch model to record all submodule inputs and outputs during a forward pass
facebookresearch_mobile-vision/mobile_cv.compare_hook_items: compare two model record hooks and yield module-level input and output tensor differences between them
facebookresearch_mobile-vision/mobile_cv.print_hook_items: print the recorded inputs and outputs with tensor norms for each submodule from a model record hook
facebookresearch_mobile-vision/mobile_cv.print_hook_items_difference: print the input and output tensor differences between two model record hooks with an optional print limit
facebookresearch_mobile-vision/mobile_cv.ModelRecordHook_get_items_dict: get a dictionary of recorded items keyed by module name from a ModelRecordHook instance after a forward pass

facebookresearch_mobile-vision/mobile_cv.create_ResultCache: create a ResultCache instance with a cache directory, cache name, logger, and path manager
facebookresearch_mobile-vision/mobile_cv.load_ResultCache_load: load cached results from disk using ResultCache.load with optional gather across ranks
facebookresearch_mobile-vision/mobile_cv.save_ResultCache_save: save arbitrary data to a per-rank pickle cache file using ResultCache.save
facebookresearch_mobile-vision/mobile_cv.check_ResultCache_has_cache: check whether a cache file already exists using ResultCache.has_cache before loading
facebookresearch_mobile-vision/mobile_cv.review_ResultCache_cache_file: review the ResultCache.cache_file property to inspect the per-rank pickle file path

facebookresearch_mobile-vision/mobile_cv.share_numpy_array_locally: create a memory-shared numpy array across local processes using multiprocessing shared memory
facebookresearch_mobile-vision/mobile_cv.SharedList_init: create a SharedList that serializes a list of objects into shared memory for cross-process access
facebookresearch_mobile-vision/mobile_cv.SharedList_getitem: retrieve a deserialized object from a SharedList by index using shared memory buffers
facebookresearch_mobile-vision/mobile_cv.SharedList_setitem: update an item in a SharedList with same-size pickled data when inplace updates are allowed
facebookresearch_mobile-vision/mobile_cv.SharedList_len: get the number of elements stored in a SharedList backed by shared memory

facebookresearch_mobile-vision/mobile_cv.get_state_dict_name_mapping: find the best name mapping between two PyTorch model state dicts based on name similarity and tensor size
facebookresearch_mobile-vision/mobile_cv.get_matching: find the best mapping between fp32 and QAT state dict items using name difference and tensor shape grouping
facebookresearch_mobile-vision/mobile_cv.levenshtein: compute the Levenshtein distance between two strings for measuring string similarity
facebookresearch_mobile-vision/mobile_cv.get_match_keys_bipartite: find the best bipartite matching between two lists of items using Levenshtein distance and shape constraints
facebookresearch_mobile-vision/mobile_cv.get_list_mapping: get the best mapping between two lists of strings using Levenshtein distance and bipartite matching

facebookresearch_mobile-vision/mobile_cv.compute_chunk_indices: compute the start and end indices for a given rank in a distributed workload
facebookresearch_mobile-vision/mobile_cv.split_data_across_ranks: split a list of elements evenly across multiple ranks using chunk indices
facebookresearch_mobile-vision/mobile_cv.distribute_workload: distribute total elements across ranks with balanced chunk sizes for parallel processing
facebookresearch_mobile-vision/mobile_cv.calculate_rank_bounds: calculate the start and end index bounds for a specific rank in multi-rank computation
facebookresearch_mobile-vision/mobile_cv.partition_elements_for_distributed_train: partition elements into balanced chunks for distributed training across multiple workers
